description: Audit SEO landing pages for value proposition clarity, CTA strength, trust proof, objection handling, and conversion friction. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

audience.description: Intended reader or buyer group in plain language; do not include unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Maximum: 180 characters. Optional; no client default.

conversion_goal.description: Desired visitor action used to evaluate conversion friction; no purchase or signup is performed. Type: String. Accepted values: "signup", "trial", "demo", "purchase", "contact_sales", "subscribe", "download", "learn_more". Default: "signup".

html.description: Page HTML supplied directly for analysis; provide this, markdown or a URL and avoid secrets in markup. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 250000 characters. Optional; no client default.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

markdown.description: Page Markdown supplied directly for analysis; provide this, html or a URL. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 50000 characters. Optional; no client default.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "auto", "homepage", "landing_page", "pricing", "feature", "blog_post", "product", "comparison_page", "docs". Default: "auto".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

traffic_source.description: Acquisition channel of the visitors this page is intended to convert. Type: String. Accepted values: "organic", "paid", "email", "social", "direct", "referral", "unknown". Default: "organic".

url.description: Absolute web page URL to analyze; use an http:// or https:// URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_page_cro_qa
title: AgentSEO Page CRO QA
